Name: Nightly model check summary the station leads can open
Description: The station leads want the nightly model check (lint, outline, trace) as one page they can open without a GitLab account, every weekday morning.

Name: Weekly PowerPoint export of the Cameo diagrams
Description: Please export the station diagrams from Cameo to PowerPoint every Friday for the station leads meeting.

Name: Units on the sensor parameters (wind in knots or m/s?)
Description: The ingest service had to guess the wind speed unit. Every sensor parameter in the model should carry its unit.

Name: Observation latency budget: station to published bulletin
Description: The system requirement allows a fixed time from observation to bulletin. SE needs the budget split across station, network, data center and publication, checked when the model changes.

Name: Check our requirement wording before the prime's next review
Description: Operations is writing new segment requirements and wants them checked against the program's requirement recipe before they go to the prime.

Name: Write access to the government repository for the prime's modelers
Description: The prime asks for Developer access so its modelers can push fixes directly into the government model.

Name: Data exchange table for the program review
Description: The program review needs a table of every data exchange between segments, with the interface and the requirement behind it.

Name: Buoy operating modes diagram for the operations manual
Description: The operations manual needs the buoy's modes and the transitions between them, current with the design.

Name: Add the new tide gauge vendor's sensor to the station
Description: Stations will receive a second tide gauge model next spring. Please add it to the station design.
